Run 22 complete.

**Result: 0 bugs found, 0 fixes — eighth consecutive 0-prod-5xx run.**

- Ran existing QA harness: 253 endpoints, all returned 2xx/4xx (1 expected 503 from `skip-trace/job` graceful-degrade when `TRACERFY_API_KEY` unset)

  - 3 Stripe-touching: `payments.create-intent`, `payments.public.create-intent`, `skip-trace/setup-payment`
  - 4 onboarding: `select-plan`, `setup-payment`, `enable-addons`, `complete` (idempotent)
- Re-ran extended harness: **265 / 272 (97.4%)** coverage, still 0 unintended 5xx
- Vite build passes (7.79s)
- Committed as `7169023`
- Updated `overnight_resume.md` with Run 22 progress

Remaining 7 untested are genuine no-go-zones: `auth/{register,login}`, `onboarding/create-tenant`, `payments/connect/{onboard,refresh}` (call Stripe regardless of body), and the 3 heavy-job triggers (`properties/trigger-import`, `drift/correct-all`, `crm/leads/score-all`) which fire work on empty `POST {}` — flagged as carry-over #1 for a future "add input guard" run.
